name: explain_functionality
description: Return a canonical description of what agent-wiki is and how to use it. Use ONLY when the user asks meta questions about the app itself — "how does this work", "what can you do", "how do I use the chat", "what's the wiki for", "how do triggers work", and similar. Do NOT call for ordinary content questions about their wiki docs (use `search_wiki` + `read_page`) or for general "how do I do X in language Y" coding help. Takes no arguments. The result is reference text — read it, then answer the user's specific question in your own words.
